usage.callShape: POST https://api.xona-agent.com/image-model/seedream-4.5 with JSON body {prompt} (optional: aspect_ratio, referenceImage[])
usage.outputShape: body.image_url (CDN JPG URL); body.image_description (echoed prompt); body.metadata.{model, aspectRatio, cdn_key}
quirks: Payment is Solana-only: paymentAccepts has a single entry on network solana with USDC asset EPjFWdd5...Dt1v. You MUST have USDC on Solana; a Base/EVM-only wallet will fail with an insufficient-funds error even if it holds plenty of EVM USDC.
x402 via payment-signature header; omit on first call to get the 402 challenge. The qa-pay/x402 client handles this automatically.
Synchronous: a single POST returns the finished image_url (~9s); no job id, no polling.
usage.guide: POST a JSON body with a required "prompt" string (optionally "aspect_ratio" like "16:9", default 1:1, and "referenceImage" array of image URLs) to https://api.xona-agent.com/image-model/seedream-4.5. It is an x402 paid endpoint costing $0.080 USDC on Solana — ensure your wallet holds USDC on Solana (EVM USDC will not be accepted). The call is synchronous and returns 200 with the generated image at body.image_url (a CDN JPG); read body.metadata for model/aspect details.
